author: Codex documentation author

scenarios.expected: Applying a group snapshots members into Approval requests; later group edits do not rewrite those requests. Non-Member+ selections and unauthorized configuration are refused; existing requests retain their recorded identities.
scenarios.actual: Created a group through Settings > Contracts > Approver groups with two Legal members; the picker offered only Administrators and Legal Team Members and adding a Contributor was refused. Applying it created one Pending Approval Request per member, each stamped with the group name, and the dialog carried the snapshot warning. A second apply on the same record was refused as a no-op and the roster was unchanged. On a record where one member already held a pending request, the dialog said "Skips 1 person who already has a request open." and the apply succeeded without a duplicate. With a member demoted to Contributor the whole apply was refused by name and the record held the same number of Pending rows before and after, so no partial roster was created; restoring their role and applying again created both rows. On a Confidential Contract an out-of-audience member produced the same whole-apply refusal by name with no rows created. Editing the membership, archiving and restoring the group all left the earlier requests exactly as they were, and archiving asked for no replacement. A demoted member still appears in the editor marked "Can no longer approve". Nadia Haddad was redirected from the pane and refused 403 on the approver-group routes while still able to apply a group to a Contract. A later evidence review relabelled three group steps: one whose 400 proved request validation rather than the role rule and whose picker list was a sample, and two whose rosters read as null. repair-groups draws the real 422 role refusal from a well-formed memberIds write, verifies the picker list is complete against the user list, and names every asked, skipped and refused person by id with whole rosters before and after.
